scope: Matched final-recipe head retraining; exposed cross-dataset development evaluation

training.population: Original 88744 eAP TRAIN40 five-rotation physical OOF features only
training.sampling: Identical torch.randint row schedules per seed in all arms
training.objective: Original fusion_loss: group-balanced phase MAE plus 0.1 quantile loss
training.optimizer: AdamW lr 0.0003, weight_decay 0.001, betas 0.9/0.999, eps 1e-8, foreach false
training.schedule: Original final-head warmup/cosine schedule, gradient norm clipped at 1
training.initialization: Identical random initialization per seed, zero output layer
training.endpoint: Last fixed update; no early stopping or validation selection
training.inverse_residual: Transform five phase fields per branch to d0*inverse_TTC; correct RGB inverse TTC by 0.3*c0, map to phase for the unchanged objective. Widths remain in phase units.

calibrated_simple_fusion.selection: Minimize group-balanced training phase absolute error only; first minimum

evaluation.population: Corrected 460-query transfer cohort, exact identities and frozen feature shards
evaluation.feature_gate: Reproduce released-head archived predictions before fitting controls; report numerical tolerance
evaluation.primary_summary: Mean per-query absolute error across the three seeds, not TTC ensembling
evaluation.bootstrap: 10000 draws over 32 complete recordings, seed 20261111; seeds kept together
limitations: Upstream estimates and temporal history held fixed
